constraints.tierB: 10-12 alphanumeric characters (permitted only for substantially better names)
constraints.excluded: Confusing letter sequences, famous chess sites, deliberate misspellings of established brands, offensive or misleading combinations

scoring.note: Legal risk is assessed separately via risk_status and never overridden by a high score.

statusDefinitions.Promising: No material conflict identified in the research performed.

outstandingChecks: Official trademark registers (IP India, WIPO, USPTO, UK IPO, EUIPO) - automated screening was not possible; every candidate needs manual or professional clearance in Nice classes 9, 16, 41 and 42.
Company and business-name registers (MCA India, Companies House, state registries) for the final shortlist.
Social handles on Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Reddit, Discord and Twitch - all Unverified in this run.
Registrar-level confirmation that a 404 RDAP domain is registrable (premium/reserved name check).
Domains in .club and .co - both were unresolvable in this run (.club registry rate-limited, .co publishes no RDAP).
curationMethod: Recommendation order applies practical brand suitability on top of the numeric score, as section 7 requires. Risk status is the primary gate: only Promising candidates are curated. Candidates are then held back when they breach the section 2 naming constraint (see per-candidate curation_flags), and arbitrary coined strings are capped at 3 of the 10 so the list is usable for a brand decision. Full numeric ranking is preserved in candidates.csv and in the ranking below.
